ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (24) has a matching target block; 2 page marker(s) preserved in place; 6 numbered section(s); attributions: Clifford, Heine, Luke 20:46–47, Matthew 23:8–10.
Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (register, omissions, glosses, attribution form).

The two opening sentences had no website counterpart and were translated fresh from the Russian. «Дерзость» (derzost') is 'insolence'; «закреплять его в нем» (zakreplyat' ego v nyom) is 'to keep them fixed in it'. In the Gospel passages «отец» stays lowercase as in the print (D0002), and «народные собрания» (narodnye sobraniya) is kept as 'public assemblies'.
